headline.en: Adeyemi started at Elche. Gordon started against Athletic
headline.es: Adeyemi fue titular en Elche. Gordon lo fue ante el Athletic

summary.en: Karim Adeyemi started the first Liga match. Anthony Gordon started the second and played 80 minutes. Both can play on the left. Only one will start against Rayo on Monday.
summary.es: Adeyemi salio en Elche. Gordon salio ante el Athletic. El lunes solo hay un puesto.

body.en: Adeyemi started at Elche. Gordon started against Athletic and stayed on for 80 minutes. El Nacional wrote that Gordon did not expect to begin the season on the bench. Both players were signed to help the attack and the press when Raphinha needs rest. Rayo defend deep, which may suit Adeyemi's runs in behind. A game where the opponent plays out may suit Gordon. Flick does not have to pick a winner for the season on Monday. He does have to pick one starter. Using both before the Feyenoord match is the simple way to keep both involved.

headline.en: Yamal played 90 minutes against Athletic and had seven shots
headline.es: Yamal jugo 90 minutos ante el Athletic y remato siete veces

summary.en: Lamine Yamal played the whole match against Athletic. MARCA counted seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. Unai Simon and the post stopped the goal. Flick said after Elche that Yamal had only just come back from three weeks off.
summary.es: Yamal jugo los 90 ante el Athletic. Siete tiros, tres a puerta. Simon y el palo evitaron el gol.

body.en: Yamal played about an hour at Elche, then 90 minutes against Athletic. MARCA's count was seven shots, three on target, five chances created, 45 completed passes and three dribbles. He hit the post. Unai Simon made saves. Flick had said after Elche that Yamal was coming back from three weeks of holiday. Luis de la Fuente has already spoken about calling him into the Spain squad. Barcelona play Rayo on Monday and Feyenoord on 9 September at 18:45. The staff are raising his minutes step by step. There is no injury. There is also no Liga goal yet. The next decision is how many minutes he plays against Rayo, not whether he can create chances. He already can.

headline.en: Barcelona beat Athletic 2-0. Raphinha and Fermin scored
headline.es: El Barca gano 2-0 al Athletic. Marcaron Raphinha y Fermin

summary.en: Barcelona beat Athletic Club 2-0 at Camp Nou. Mundo Deportivo said Unai Simon and two shots against the post stopped a bigger score. Raphinha and Fermin scored. Cubarsi and Pedri started. Gavi did not. Barcelona have seven Liga goals and none conceded.
summary.es: El Barca gano 2-0. Raphinha y Fermin marcaron. Siete goles a favor y cero en contra.

body.en: Athletic visited Camp Nou and lost 2-0. Raphinha scored. Fermin Lopez scored. Both played high, in the space a centre-forward would usually occupy. Pau Cubarsi started. Pedri started. Gavi was out. Gordon started on the left. Mundo Deportivo said Unai Simon and two shots against the post kept the score down. Barcelona have now scored seven in two Liga games and conceded none. Elche were beaten 5-0. Athletic were a harder night. Rayo on Monday will defend deeper than both. That is the next test, not the table.
